author: Rob NYC 78
title: Major Playback Control Bugs — No Response From Developers
content:
I’ve used Evermusic Pro and generally liked the app, but since the recent update, basic playback controls no longer work properly on my iPhone 17 Pro running iOS 26.6.

Not only do the hardware controls on my headphones and earbuds no longer work for play/pause, next/previous track, or volume, but the Evermusic audio player also does not appear on the iPhone Lock Screen while music is playing.

This means there is essentially no convenient way to control playback. If I want to pause a song, skip a track, or otherwise control my music, I have to unlock my phone, manually open Evermusic Pro, and use the controls inside the app itself.

I’ve tested the hardware controls with multiple devices, including Beats Studio Pro and OnePlus Buds, with the same result. These controls work normally with other audio apps, so the problem appears to be specific to Evermusic Pro.

I contacted the developers/support about these issues on July 16th, but unfortunately they have neither been resolved nor meaningfully addressed.

For a paid “Pro” music player, functioning headphone controls and Lock Screen playback controls are fundamental features, not optional conveniences. It’s especially frustrating because Evermusic Pro otherwise has a lot to offer.

I’d be happy to revise my rating if the developers acknowledge and fix these problems, but until then, I can’t recommend Evermusic Pro in its current state.

author: ArcadeJedi
title: Great app if you own a digital music library that just keeps getting better.
content: I have been using this app for my digital music library since 2018, and while some features may have taken a little longer to implement than expected or promised (Normalization), the developers take really good care of it and continue to build upon what was already a great foundation years ago, it has come such a long way and as of Summer 2026, it's a near perfect music app, packed with features, with great support, and very few bugs that are often fixed very quickly. This app has a lot of great things about it, things you can’t get in other music apps, such as importing and exporting, editing files and folders, wi-fi drives and transferring, cloud services, the support of multiple audio formats, normalization and so much more. It’s fantastic. The UI could use a little bit more customization options but they have made great strides. Overall, you’re not going to find another app with so many high quality features. If you value owning your own digital music library, and like being able to have full control over what song goes where, names of files, full audio tags, album covers, song covers, alongside every other feature a music app should have such as equalizer, a search function, fully customizable playlists etc. then this is a must have app. Mind you, it's not always peachy, the devs do mess up from time to time but they listen to feedback and adjust course. Worth the asking price for premium.

author: Wlcws
title: Great Offline Music Player to replace Apple Music
content:
I finally gave up after years of frustration caused by trying to use iTunes to add music files I already owned to my iPhone and then play them using Apple Music. It seems the main purpose of those two Apple apps are to generate monthly income for Apple cloud storage. 

All I wanted was an old fashioned MP3 player, like the first iPod Nano, that didn’t push me to use the cloud or bombard me with targeted ads. After a lot of reading, I thankfully settled on EverMusic Pro. I held of writing a review for a month to make sure my opinion hadn’t changed.

EverMusic Pro IS the best way to listen to complete albums and concerts. And it offers several methods of downloading and/or connecting to that music. There are so many choices & options that you are certain to find a combination that suits you. It also includes an MP3 Tag editor and it allows you to add your own Cover Art. Both of those are necessary for putting a collection together. And, unlike Apple Music, it appears to be stable because the album covers I chose to add on July 31st are still being displayed on September 1st.

title: Nice Update, but...
content:
Before anything, I'm still very happy with the app; it's my primary music player. Anyone looking for a feature-complete, premium feeling music player will be happy with this. That said I do have a smallish grievance with this newest update.

Since updating the app it seems the algorithm or whatever system is in place for finding Album Art now prioritizes finding images of the artists who were involved with each song over the album they are actually a part of.

This is nice for listening to songs by artist, however since I listen to a lot of soundtracks involving multiple artists I'm now seeing some songs using the official album art and then some of them using random images of the artists involved for each one song.

Another symptom of this effect is leaving a song completely blank if it can't find a picture of the artist instead of resorting to using the actual album art. Moreover what official art I am getting is in lower quality even when I have "Highest" turned on.

Possible fixes:
- Manual Album Art based on tags
- Revert or tweak the album art download system

Maybe I'm nitpicking but this hurts my experience with the app because now my albums appear less like albums and more like playlists with random songs thrown in. I can't help feeling like I miss the previous version.

author: 흘러내린별빛
title: 쓸만한 음악 스트리밍 플레이어 입니다.
content:
지난번에 혹평을 한 이후로 사용하지 않다가 오랜만에 설치해보았습니다.
그동안 업데이트를 통해서 한글 출력문제는 말끔히 해결된 것 같군요.
음악이 제대로 나오니 거기에 대해서 더이상 평할 필요는 없을 것 같구요. ー그냥 기초적인 음악 플레이어의 성능입니다.ー

인터페이스가 다소 불편합니다.(아이패드 버전)
하단의 메뉴가 마구 널부러져 있는데 그걸 조절할 방법이 없군요. 
사용하지 않는 메뉴는 OFF 할 수 있도록 만들어 주는 것이 사용자 경험을 더욱 풍부하게 만들어주리라 생각합니다.
하단에 아이콘이 너무 빡빡하게 깔려있으니 뭔가 꾸역꾸역 사용하고 있다는 생각이 드네요.

네트워크 경로를 조정할 수 있도록 하는 옵션도 추가해주면 좋겠습니다.
아니, 기본적으로 네트워크를 추가할 때에 본 앱이 '제멋대로' 해버린다는 느낌을 받았습니다.
Nplayer를 참조한다면 도움이 되겠지요.
스트리밍 플레이어중에 Nplayer만한 앱은 아직 보지 못했습니다.
똑같은 것을 바라는 것은 아닙니다만 해당 앱에 필요한 편의기능은 갖추어주는 것이 좋겠지요.

다음 업데이트를 기대하겠습니다.
흥하세요~

author: [Peter.Parker]
title: Good app but with an average user interface
content:
Good app but the user interface could be improved.

The WiFi-Drive is a great idea but it doesn't allow the upload of entire folders. To upload a folder one has to create the folder with a web browser, move inside the new folder on the iPhone, move inside the source folder, highlight the files, drag/drop them in the browser, move back one level above the source and destination folders. A process that is unnecessary convoluted.

If Evermusic Pro had a more refined user interface and upload that supports folders, it would easily be better (and successful ) than other apps like VOX.
